event.name: Idaho Falls YMCA Fall Family Festival

profile.description: 2026 outreach prospect for Hulk's late-season route. Idaho Falls Family YMCA Fall Family Festival is Saturday, September 12, 2026 from 9:00 AM-2:00 PM at Broadway Plaza on Memorial Drive, alongside the Idaho Falls Farmers Market. Official YMCA contact page provides a web contact form and main phone 208-523-0600; no direct event email was verified. Intended outreach angle is a small pay-for-play inflatable family area if the event permits it.
